notes: Programme M.01 already prescribes the massing: two 5-storey wings (≤22 m) along Mazowiecka and Wybrzeże Słowackiego joined by a corner dominant ≤45 m; 2 basement levels (parking + civil shelter); 403 staff; 24 m² cellular offices.
Site: 3,729 m² triangle at the south bridgehead of Grunwaldzki Bridge (1910, stone pylons; planned reconstruction of historic pylon helmets) — the tower must converse with the pylons.

Teams: W1 rules register + clarifications + programme; W2 zoning plan, heritage, survey geometry (PL-2000 → local grid), geotech, trees, neighbours; W3 building law/WT, fire (high-rise W), accessibility, zero-emission (EPBD); W4 competition trends, visualisation craft, façade aesthetics, Wrocław context, cost benchmarks.
Toolchain: Blender 5.2 Cycles + OIDN denoise verified; 100×70 cm board pipeline (HTML/SVG → Chromium PDF, Inter typeface) verified at exact print size.
Exclusion rule enforced in every agent brief: no information about entries/results of THIS competition.
